projects.project_name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace Split Payments & Escrow Orchestration
projects.problem: Manual agency payouts and refund processing caused heavy operational overhead, delayed seller disbursements, and checkout drop-offs during high-value real estate transaction reservations.
projects.discovery: Interviewed 35 brokerage partners and analyzed 12,000 checkout attempts; found 18% cart drop-offs stemmed from lack of flexible escrow splits and localized payment choices.
projects.technical_context: Integrated MangoPay and Adyen APIs to enable multi-party escrow, automated split payments, real-time KYC verification, and automated wallet balance orchestration.
actions: Authored end-to-end PRDs and API sequence diagrams for automated escrow funding and disbursement.
Negotiated custom fee structures and SLA guarantees with payment gateway account teams.
Designed fallback retry mechanics between Adyen and MangoPay to guarantee high transaction success.
results: Reduced transaction drop-offs by 18% across high-value rental reservations.
Automated 92% of monthly merchant payouts, reducing finance manual reconciliation hours by 60 hours/month.
Achieved 99.8% payment processing reliability across peak marketing campaign periods.

projects.project_name: Subscription Cancellation Redesign & Retention Funnel Optimization
projects.problem: Small and medium property agencies were experiencing high monthly subscription churn, with 30% citing inflexible billing cycles and lack of visibility into listing ROI.
projects.discovery: Audited exit surveys and segmented Mixpanel event streams to uncover that 45% of churners cancelled during months with seasonal inventory slowdowns.
projects.technical_context: Created conditional retention flows, automated pause/resume subscription mechanics, discount offers, and targeted in-app value reinforcement using CleverTap and Mixpanel.
actions: Designed personalized cancellation intervention flows with pause options and tailored listing boost credits.
Implemented real-time churn risk indicators triggering automated Customer Success outreach via Webhooks.
results: Reduced gross subscription cancellations by 23% within the first two quarters.
Saved an estimated $340K in annualized recurring revenue through automated pause mechanics.
Boosted customer satisfaction score (CSAT) around subscription transparency from 62% to 84%.

projects.project_name: Delivery Slot Optimization & Automated Field Operations Routing
projects.problem: Field verification agents faced severe travel inefficiencies, leading to delayed listing inspections, missed SLAs, and frustrated property sellers.
projects.discovery: Conducted ride-alongs with field inspectors and reviewed 6 months of dispatch logs; identified clusters of overlapping geographic appointments scheduled hours apart.
projects.technical_context: Formulated appointment clustering rules, geofencing validations, and dynamic slot reservation APIs within the internal operations engine.
actions: Defined algorithmic assignment rules to group inspection slots by geographic density and traffic corridors.
Built responsive agent mobile dashboard with turn-by-turn routing and real-time status updates.
results: Elevated on-time inspection completion rate from 78% to 94%.
Decreased average agent travel time between appointments by 28%.
Expanded daily inspection capacity by 22% with no additional headcount.
